title: World Flora Online Plant List June 2026

license.label: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal
evidence: The official Zenodo record metadata has license.id=cc-zero.
World Flora Online's contributor guidance states that Taxonomic Backbone data are placed in the public domain under CC0.

citation: World Flora Online Consortium. (2026). World Flora Online Plant List June 2026 (Version 2026-06). World Flora Online. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20782718

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field only when that exact suffix is present.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation, name tokens and authorship tokens.
matchingContract.accepted: Exactly one WFO 2026-06 accepted species has the exact normalized scientific name, authorship and species rank.
matchingContract.redirect: Exactly one WFO 2026-06 synonym name has the exact normalized scientific name, authorship and species rank and explicitly points to one accepted WFO species.
matchingContract.ambiguous: Exact WFO records resolve to more than one accepted WFO species.
matchingContract.unmatched: No exact WFO species-name record exists.
matchingContract.withheld: The COL authorship boundary cannot be removed exactly or a required WFO accepted target is absent.
matchingContract.upstreamOnly: A WFO 2026-06 accepted species is not the unambiguous target of any COL26.8 plant record.
matchingContract.forbidden: No fuzzy, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, punctuation-stripped, edit-distance, phonetic, token-reordered, genus-substitution or authority-only matching is permitted.

distributionBoundary.statement: The official 132.6 MB archive and its expanded members remain external reproducibility inputs. The repository commits only the source ledger, generator, import ledger and minimal derived crosswalk.
distributionBoundary.evidenceBoundary: The crosswalk supplies release-pinned nomenclatural identifiers and explicit status relationships. It is not evidence of phylogeny, ecology, distribution, extinction, fossils, media, translation, dossier maturity or expert review.
